newsitem.title: USA: BPA cuts Wed. peak power by $5/MWh, off-peak flat.
newsitem.headline: BPA cuts Wed. peak power by $5/MWh, off-peak flat.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) lowered its prices for firm power during hours ending 0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2200 PST on Wednesday by $5.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Tuesday.
Up to 300 megawatts of firm power during those hours was offered at $40.00 per MWh to Northwest buyers and at $41.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
For Tuesday, BPA had offered firm power for 0700-2200 PST at$45.00 (Northwest) and $46.00 (COB).
Wednesday offers for firm power during off-peak hours (0100-0600 and 2300-2400) were unchanged at $12.50 per MWh.
Non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 was also offered at $12.50 per MWh for Wednesday, while hours ending0600, 2300 were priced at $20.75.
BPA also offered displacement power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST at $9.00 per MWh.
